dog.description_text:
Marlo is a 7-year-old Australian Shepherd mix who weighs around 39 lbs and is such a sweet, affectionate girl. She loves to snuggle, sit close to her people, and soak up as many pets as she can get.

She’s friendly with people, does well around other dogs, and is both house-trained and crate-trained. Marlo has an easy, loving personality and would be very happy in a home where she can stay close to her people and enjoy plenty of affection.

Registered adopters interested in Marlo can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
